ShortDescription.Value: Collect local error evidence and export a support report. Suspect rankings are not proof of fault.

Publish.LongDescription:
BETA — log evidence is not a definitive crash diagnosis.
WHAT IT DOES Scans available local logs and presents errors, context and possible suspects.
HOW TO USE Open CrashLens, rescan, inspect an entry and export a support report when needed. Reports are saved under ModsData/CrashLens.
CURRENT LIMITATIONS No evidence found does not mean every mod is healthy. Suspect ranking cannot prove which mod caused an error. Reports are not uploaded automatically. User-profile paths are redacted, but inspect all reports and screenshots for private data before posting.
Publish.ChangeLog:
1.1.4-beta.1 — Maintenance beta
Reset monitoring state cleanly on reinitialization and auto-open state per city. Strengthen case-insensitive profile-path redaction, replace misleading healthy/causality claims and correct settings registration.
Build/offline checks do not establish full in-game verification.
